description: [et_pb_section fb_built=”1″ admin_label=”section” _builder_version=”4.16″ global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_row admin_label=”row” _builder_version=”4.16″ background_size=”initial” background_position=”top_left” background_repeat=”repeat” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”4_4″ _builder_version=”4.16″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||”][et_pb_text admin_label=”Text” _builder_version=”4.27.6″ background_size=”initial” background_position=”top_left” background_repeat=”repeat” global_colors_info=”{}”]More mortifying than a Monday morning management huddle. More screams than a week-long team-building retreat. And more hair-raising than that waste-of-space dimwit Hank from Accounting. (That fucking idiot) The Sunday Scaries can buzz off because The Electric Slideshow is back, and the key takeaway here is… TERROR! Join us on Friday, October 16th at Arcade Comedy Theater, as hosts Alyssa Moon and Mike DiGuglielmo curate and moderate a series of deep dives into the bizarre and the bloodcurdling… the eerie and the unnerving… or probably just some Zoomer nonsense they found on r/creepypasta. Oh, your Sonic the Hedgehog game is haunted? Grow up! In addition to petrifying presentations by Alyssa and Mike, this supernatural seminar features slimy slideshows by Cassi Bruno, Anne Casper, Roy Gloeckl, and, perhaps… OTHERS! Do not miss The Electric Slideshow. Oogie boogie boogie.[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

name: Iván Fematt "La Mole"
description: Iván Fematt "La Mole" es uno de los comediantes más reconocidos y queridos de México. Con un estilo irreverente, auténtico y lleno de humor norteño, ha conquistado al público a través de sus exitosos podcasts, programas y shows en vivo. Conocido por ser parte del exitoso podcast Hermanos de Leche junto a Adrián Marcelo, La Mole mezcla anécdotas personales, improvisación y comedia cotidiana que conectan de inmediato con la audiencia. Su carisma y experiencia sobre el escenario hacen de cada show una experiencia única, llena de risas, interacción y momentos inolvidables. Ahora llega con un espectáculo completamente en vivo donde el público podrá disfrutar de su humor sin filtros, ocurrencias inesperadas y el estilo que lo ha convertido en una figura clave de la comedia latina actual.

name: Las Damitas Histeria
description: Damitas Histeria es un exitoso show de comedia en vivo que combina stand-up, podcast e interacción con el público en una experiencia fresca, divertida y completamente diferente. Bárbara Malacara y Verónica Monti convierten las historias más caóticas de las relaciones, las amistades, la familia y la vida cotidiana en una noche de risas, confesiones y reflexión, con el estilo irreverente que las ha convertido en uno de los fenómenos digitales de habla hispana. Cada función es única gracias a la participación del público y a la improvisación que surge en el escenario

name: Carrot Top
description: Picking a comedy show to see in Vegas is a daunting task. That's why we've done the research for you. We know you deserve the best while visiting the Strip! So, make your way down to the Luxor and check out Carrot Top, Vegas's Best Male Stand-Up Comedian. This guy is an absolute riot, combining comical commentary on current events with outrageous prop comedy. He's got a trunk full of bizarre items, including several of his own inventions, which add an extra layer of hilarity to his jokes. Add in his wacky personality, over-the-top red hair, and the fact that he barely takes the time to breathe between jokes, and you're in for a show that will have you doubled over laughing from start to finish. It's no wonder Carrot Top has been praised as both Entertainer of the Year and Comedian of the Year. His shows are, quite simply, one heck of a good time. Trust us - you don't want to miss an opportunity to see this guy in person! | Please note: You must be 16 years or older to attend. Anyone 18 years or younger must be accompanied by an adult. name: Irene Tu
description: Irene Tu is a Los Angeles-based stand-up comedian, actor and writer who honed her chops in San Francisco. Her first comedy album WE’RE DONE NOW debuted at #1 on the iTunes comedy charts. Paste Magazine praised Irene’s “quick wit, relaxed stage presence, and hilariously off-the-wall observations” in this album that “ticks all the boxes of a winning introduction, and then some.” One of Netflix’s “Introducing” comics of 2022, her show in 2024 was named one of the funniest by the LA Times. She’s a regular at festivals and clubs around the country and has opened for comics like Taylor Tomlinson, Ronny Chieng, and Patton Oswalt. You may recognize Irene from After Midnight, Hulu, Comedy Central, Netflix is a Joke, Don’t Tell Comedy or her viral stand up clips which have amassed over 30 million views on social media.

name: FREE Intro To Improv Class
description: Free Saturday Improv Class2 hours. 30 spots. 100% fun.Taking an improv class is like a workout for your confidence and creativity. With no script and no pressure, you’ll learn to say “Yes, and…” to new ideas, think on your feet, and adapt when life throws curveballs. Along the way, you’ll sharpen your communication, strengthen your listening skills, and discover how freeing it feels to let go of perfection.And yes—you’ll laugh. A lot.What You’ll Do:Hour 1: Build the FoundationDiscover the “Yes, and…” mindset, play warm-up games, and unlock tools to collaborate, support, and create without fear of being wrong.Hour 2: Play the GamesJump into classic short-form improv games like Professor Know-It-All, Freeze and Justify, Conducted Story, and more. You’ll put your new skills into action, connect with others, and surprise yourself with what you create.By the end, you’ll walk out feeling lighter, braver, and more creative—with stories (and friends) you’ll keep long after class ends.Who’s Teaching:Your guide is Kevin Small, a nationally recognized improviser and teacher.Featured on HBO’s Sketch Pad 2Former Training Director & Performer at Four Day Weekend (one of the most respected improv institutions in the country)Performed for 12+ years with ACME Comedy’s Main Company in Los Angeles, where he wrote and performed sketch comedy alongside stars like Bryan Cranston, Mayim Bialik, Wendi McLendon-Covey, Joel McHale, and Neil Flynn.Kevin brings decades of stage and teaching experience, a supportive style, and a passion for helping people discover their creative voice.By the end, you’ll walk out feeling lighter, braver, and more creative—with stories (and friends) you’ll keep long after class ends.Why Join?✔ Only 30 spots available — keeps it intimate, supportive, and fun✔ No experience needed (improv isn’t about being “funny”)✔ Build confidence and flexibility in just 2 hours✔ 100% FREEReady to jump in? Special Event Ages 21 and Over


Comedian Bobcat Goldthwait first appeared on the David Letterman Show at the age of 20 and has an ongoing career as a writer, director, actor, voice actor, and stand-up. As a comedian, Bobcat has starred in numerous HBO/Showtime specials, performed in venues worldwide, and even went on tour as an opening act for the band Nirvana. Well-known for his roles in “Scrooged” with Bill Murray and as Zed in the “Police Academy” franchise, Goldthwait has become a well-respected Award Winning Director, too. His directorial works include feature films World’s Greatest Dad, starring Robin Williams, Willow Creek, starring Bigfoot, God Bless America, Windy City Heat, Sleeping Dogs Lie, and the documentaries Call Me Lucky and Joy Ride. In addition to being a 4x Sundance Alumni, Goldthwait’s films have played internationally, including the Deauville Film Festival and San Sebastian Film Festival. Bobcat has been honored with the German Independent Honorary Award at the Oldenburg Film Festival for his collective works and was awarded “Filmmaker on the Edge” at the Provincetown Film Festival by his hero John Waters. His TV direction includes his series, Misfits and Monsters, Jimmy Kimmel Live, Community, Maron, Those Who Can’t, and many more. Goldthwait has directed numerous standup comedy specials for folks like Patton Oswalt, Marc Maron, Ron Funches, Kyle Kinane, Cameron Esposito, Mo Willems, Gary Gulman, Hari Kondabolu, Eugene Mirman, and Pete Davidson to name a few. Bobcat is currently working on several new film projects and has started his autobiography.

description: DJ Sandhu DJ Sandhu is a Sacramento-based stand-up comedian celebrated for his "brilliantly ignorant," absurdist humor and legendary, expansive black beard. Born to Indian parents, he famously bypassed medical school to pursue comedy out of spite after a rude encounter with another comic. Today, his sharp, unpredictable routines have made him a staple at major clubs like Laughs Unlimited, as well as a performer on international stages like the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Driven by a diverse creative background, Sandhu initially pursued a music career in punk and metal bands before finding his calling in stand-up. On stage, his striking visual presence serves as frequent comedic fuel, inspiring hilarious, surreal routines about his personal life and heavy scrutiny during airport travel. description: JIM SPINNATO has spent more than three decades turning nightclub stages into scenes of chaos, laughter, and genuine disbelief. A former U.S. Air Force serviceman turned full-time entertainer, he built his name as a straight magician before layering in comedy hypnosis, evolving into the sharp-witted hybrid act he's known for today. Since 2011, SPINNATO has held a standing residency at Comix Roadhouse at Mohegan Sun, where his shows have played to thousands of guests and earned him TripAdvisor's "Best of the Best" honor for 2025. His signature bit — reading minds with the help of "the world's only mindreading goose" — has become legend among regulars, backed by sleight-of-hand card work engineered to leave grown adults genuinely stumped. SPINNATO now headlines his all-new Anything Goes Magic Show weekly at Comix Roadhouse — Thursday and Friday at 5pm, Saturday at 4pm, Sunday at 5pm — with his Comedy Hypnosis Show running bimonthly. Strictly 18+, the show trades rabbits and wands for stand-up comedy, audience roasting, and unpredictable, mind-blowing magic built for a rowdier crowd. He's also brought the act to the Garde Arts Center, Six Flags New England, UConn, Providence College, Post University, and dozens of corporate and private events across New England. name: Brooklyn Power Hour NOW ON A NEW NIGHT!
Corinne Fisher, James Mattern, Dara Jemmott, Mariel Jimenez, Tom Zappia, Zahid Dewji, Napoleon Emill
description: Prime-Time Comedy in Brooklyn!FEATURING SPECIAL GUEST COMEDIANS...Lineup BelowFeaturingCorinne FisherJames MatternDara JemmottMariel JimenezTom ZappiaZahid DewjiNapoleon EmillCORINNE FISHER is a stand-up comedian, writer, director & actor originally from Union, NJ and currently residing in New York City. Most recently, she directed the debut comedy special from her and herlongtime comedy partner, Krystyna Hutchinson. The special is set to air in February 2022. The duo is most known for co-creating and co-hosting their groundbreaking, genre-creating GUYS WE F*CKED: The Anti Slut-Shaming podcast — a vulnerable firsthand look into modern female sexuality from a comedic perspective — which began tearing up charts in December 2013. Over eight years later, the show boasts millions of listeners nationally and internationally and has inspired dozens of female-led comedy/sexuality shows. The podcast has hit #1 on the iTunes comedy charts multiple times and has been featured in Vogue, Interview, Esquire, The Huffington Post, The Daily Beast, Splitsider, Mother Jones, Perez Hilton, Elle, A.V. Club, E! News, People, US Magazine, Bust, CNN, and The Village Voice as well as on Sirius Radio, and NBC’s Last Call with Carson Daly. High-profile guests include Amanda Knox, Amber Rose, and Fran Drescher. The podcast was also turned into a book by HarperCollins entitled F*CKED: Being Sexually Explorative and Self-Confident in a World That’s Screwed and the duo was asked to give a TEDx talk exploring topics from their show.Corinne first made a splash in the comedy scene with her debut one-woman show Corinne Fisher: I STALK YOU (Dir. David Crabb) which had a run at The Peoples Improv Theater in the Summer of 2010 and was a featured show in Time Out New York. Since then, she has been a regular on the stand-up scene selling out shows at world-famous clubs like The Comedy Store, New York Comedy Club, The Stand, and Caroline’s on Broadway and theaters such as The Wilbur in Boston, the Athenaeum inChicago, and the Tribeca Performing Arts Center in New York City. Fisher has also been selected to perform at the prestigious Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in both Montreal and Toronto, Moontower Comedy Festival, Boston Comedy Festival, and cult favorite Skankfest. She’s been seen on FOX’s LAUGHS and her show with fellow comic Katie Hannigan THE COMEDIENNE PROJECT (Dir. Ted Alexandro) was selected for the NYC Fringe Festival.Fisher remains an innovator in podcasting, having co-created the WITHOUT A COUNTRY podcast which she currently co-hosts with comedian Shayne Smith, a weekly news shows that covers stories using aslew of sources from various political perspectives. She also previously co-hosted and co-created TWO LESS LONELY GIRLS, a podcast for adult Justin Bieber fans with comedian Rosebud Baker.Right now, Corinne is working on writing and producing several projects including the cartoon series MYSTERY SQUAD GALS created by Ryan Duff. In an unexpected plot twist, she also took over her Dad’sbaseball card and horror collectibles store, Perfectly Centered, in 2021.James Mattern is a nationally headlining comic and media personality, who has quickly become one of the most beloved emcees in New York. James has released two albums, "No Segues" in 2019 and "The Check Spot" in 2021, the latter of which debuted at #1 on iTunes Comedy Charts and was voted Interrobang’s “Album of the Year” in 2021. The development of "The Check Spot" album was recorded from its conception and later released as a documentary film by the same name on YouTube on June 3, 2021.James has warmed up audiences on a number of TV shows in both New York and Los Angeles, including Netflix’s "Patriot Act with Hasan Minhaj," ABC’s "The View," NBC’s "Bring the Funny," Netflix’s "The Break with Michelle Wolf," and ABC’s "The Chew." He has also appeared on PlutoTV’s "Kevin Hart Presents Comedy in Color," MSG Network’s "The Bracket," Manhattan Neighborhood Network’s "Chris Gethard Presents," Fox Sports "One's Garbage Time with Katie Nolan," WWE Network's "The List," and MSG Network’s "People Talking Sports," to name a few.Currently, James can be heard as a co-hosts "The SDR (Sex, Drugs, and Rock & Roll) Show" on G.A.S. Digital.Zahid Dewji is an NYC based comedian. He was a former staff writer on NBC’s The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, as well as the head writer on OFTV’s Roast of Bert Kreischer & The Roast of Whitney Cummings. Born in Queens, NY to East African Indian immigrants, the "Z-man" (as no one calls him) was raised in Houston where he began his comedy career and quickly became a Texas favorite. Zahid has toured the country with comedy icon Whitney Cummings as well as internet sensation Noel Miller and has been featured on countless comedy festivals including Oddball Comedy Fest, Laughing Skull and Moontower Comedy Festival. His debut special “Where is God?” was released in 2023 with Don’t Tell Comedy. He also has a new set filmed with OFTV available to stream exclusively on Only Fans (yes, really).

name: Liam Dalton, Tom Zappia, Dennis Rooney, Whitney Chanel, Salma Zaky
description: TGIF Comedy in Brooklyn! FEATURING SPECIAL GUEST COMEDIANS...(Lineup coming soon)FeaturingLiam DaltonTom ZappiaDennis RooneyWhitney ChanelSalma ZakyLiam Dalton is a New York City based comedian, actor and writer, born and raised in Queens. His conversational style mixes observational humor with personal stories of growing up the only boy in a big Irish Catholic household. Fresh off of performing on Bert Kreischer’s “Fully Loaded“ cruise, Liam performed on the Impractical Jokers cruise and the Netflix is a Joke comedy festival in Los Angeles. He has opened for big acts like Mark Normand, Rachel Feinstein and Cipha Sounds. He just finished his stint as a radio personality on New York radio station 94.7 the block. When he’s not touring the country or seas, Liam performs all over New York City and uploads sketches to his social media daily. Whitney Chanel is a New York City comedian whose work has been featured on VH1, Bravo, Tubi, BuzzFeed, and The Sweet Spot. Known for her sharp storytelling and authentic perspective, Whitney creates a space where audiences can laugh, relate, and see their own life experiences reflected on stage. Her comedy is honest, engaging, and unapologetically real, inviting people to embrace their authentic selves while finding humor in everyday life.Originally from the Bay Area, Salma Zaky moved to Los Angeles to attend college, where she began her comedy journey. Salma has filmed a mini stand-up special with OnlyFans on OFTV (unfortunately clothed), as well as a Don't Tell taping. She now resides in Brooklyn, NY to take her anxiety and career to new heights.

name: My Cousin Vlad & Balkan Comedy Night
description: Eastville Comedy Club is Brooklyn's oldest comedy clubGet ready for an unforgettable night of comedy as international comedy sensation My Cousin Vlad brings his wildly popular, high-energy stand-up show to North America.Macedonian-Australian comedian My Cousin Vlad has built a massive international following with millions of views across social media, earning fans with his razor-sharp observations, unforgettable characters and hilarious takes on family, culture and everyday life.Vlad's comedy draws from his experiences growing up in a Balkan immigrant family in Australia and the hilarious collision between old-school traditions and modern life. From marriage, kids and chaotic family gatherings to tradie culture, corporate life, building a duplex and the characters you meet along the way, Vlad turns the everyday into fast-paced, brutally funny stand-up.His unique style blends clever storytelling, spot-on impressions, quick improvisation and sharp observational comedy into a show that feels distinctly Balkan while remaining relatable to audiences from every background.Whether he's poking fun at Balkan traditions, navigating modern Australian life or exposing the universal insanity of family, My Cousin Vlad delivers an authentic, unpredictable and uniquely hilarious comedy experience.The night also features Balkan Comedy Night founder Ryan Radusinovic, who has been featured on CBS, Amazon Prime, Just For Laughs and the Netflix Is a Joke Festival. His comedy blends animated storytelling, pitch-perfect impressions, clever observations and merciless roasts. Ryan has opened for Bill Burr, Yannis Pappas, Cedric the Entertainer and Pablo Francisco, and currently tours with Jack Jr.

name: Wait, What’s Sri Lanka? - **THIS IS A COMEDY SPECIAL TAPING**
description: Buying a ticket means you consent to potentially being on camera. ARRIVAL INFO:Please arrive early to be seated and experience any of the pre-built pre-show. We recommend showing up at least 30 minutes before show time. Once the show begins there is no late seating because the cameras will be rolling. Wait, What’s Sri Lanka? is a one hour stand-up special, written by Shenuque and directed by Sunny Laprade, this show is for anyone who has ever felt invisible. The show explores the joy of embracing all parts of your identity while navigating the pain of not feeling seen. Shenuque uses a narrative stand-up style to talk about their life through the lens of being Sri Lankan and how that intersects with their other identities. The show reveals how interconnected we all are. Regardless of whether or not you're Sri Lankan, this show is for you. Topics include race, gender, sexuality, and of course, aunties. If you enjoy stand-up comedy that weaves together humor with a compelling narrative, you will enjoy this show.All graphics are designed by: Elliot Davis.Music by: DJ UshkaOriginal Music by: Roshane KarunaratneBio:Shenuque is a Sri Lankan American comedian born and raised on Staten Island. Their stand-up is infused with a passion for storytelling and an enrapturing stage presence. They are currently touring their debut stand-up special, Wait, What’s Sri Lanka?, a show for anyone who has ever felt invisible. They’ve graced the stage in Off-Broadway productions and contributed their writing talents to HBO Max. They’ve worked as a director for the Murmuration Theater Company and co-founded the award-winning podcast studio Many Sided Media, where you can regularly hear their voice acting on the show My First Dungeon. description: Irene Tu is a Los Angeles-based stand-up comedian, actor and writer who honed her chops in San Francisco. Her first comedy album WE’RE DONE NOW debuted at #1 on the iTunes comedy charts. Paste Magazine praised Irene’s “quick wit, relaxed stage presence, and hilariously off-the-wall observations” in this album that “ticks all the boxes of a winning introduction, and then some.” One of Netflix’s “Introducing” comics of 2022, her show in 2024 was named one of the funniest by the LA Times. She’s a regular at festivals and clubs around the country and has opened for comics like Taylor Tomlinson, Ronny Chieng, and Patton Oswalt. name: Jay Leno
description: Acclaimed TV late night show host, admired stand-up comedian, best-selling children’s book author, much-in-demand corporate speaker, TV and movie voice-over artist, pioneering car builder and mechanic, and philanthropist…Jay Leno is widely characterized as “the hardest working man in show business.” Jay Leno’s late night television ratings domination included two decades as the host of the #1- rated “The Tonight Show with Jay Leno” – he never lost a ratings year in which he served as host. Jay Leno is currently hosting “YOU BET YOUR LIFE” and completed the second season returning in syndication in Fall 2022. This comedy show is co-hosted by Jay’s longtime Tonight Show bandleader Kevin Eubanks and features strangers teaming up to answer a series of trivia questions with the goal of winning thousands of dollars. Leno, also produces and is host of the CNBC Television series “JAY LENO’S GARAGE” now in its third season. “Jay Leno’s Garage” explores the world of cars, never forgetting that it’s the people behind the wheel who provide the real stories. The series debuted in October 2015 and delivered CNBC’s most-watched first season in network history. New episodes of “Jay Leno’s Garage” can be viewed on CNBC throughout the year. The show is an outgrowth of JAY LENOS GARAGE YOUTUBE CHANNEL which Leno produces and has an international following on the Web and has garnered several Emmy Awards and nominations for Outstanding Special Class–Short-Format Nonfiction Programs. His new product line JAY LENO’S GARAGE ADVANCED VEHICLE CARE launched in December of 2016 and has been well received by the Automotive Industry worldwide. Products are available on www.lenosgarage.com. When he’s not on TV, Leno performs more than 100 stand-up shows annually across the country and internationally; participates in numerous charity and corporate events, does voice-overs for animated series, pens children’s books, and writes a monthly column in various automotive magazines. And in his “spare” time (as if he has any), he enjoys working on his collection of classic cars and motorcycles. In fact, he has built a number of cars, including an acclaimed eco- car in his eco-friendly green garage. Leno is the recipient of many honors, including Emmy, People’s Choice, and TV Guide awards, Harris Poll selection as most popular star on television, the Hasty Pudding Award at Harvard University, The Mark Twain Prize, a star on Hollywood’s Walk of Fame, and being the first person to drive the pace car of all major NASCAR events. He and his wife Mavis, an ardent human rights activist, live in Los Angeles.

description: Guests - check out up and coming talent + special drop in guests working out new material. Select drop-in guests! Purchase a ticket below to enjoy. Comedians may no longer sign up at the start of the mic, but must ign up in advance ONLINE only. NOTE: purchasing the ticket below does NOT include performance - this is for guests only. Check FlappersComedy.com for audition details! Full restaurant and bar service available. We value the importance of creating a positive and supportive comedy community, and in order to continue to provide opportunities, we are asking all comedians and guests to observe the following code of ethics: Funny: *PG to PG-13 comedy at the open mics - because the open mics (especially the bar shows) are in shared areas where guests from the mainroom shows (sometimes all ages) are located, we are asking comedians to air on the side of working clean. If you are not sure whether or not your joke is clean or dirty, it’s dirty. It doesn’t need to be squeaky clean, but shouldn’t be any crazier than something you’d see on a Tonight Show set. *Please do not scream or yell at the top of your lungs. You have a microphone to amplify you. Our rooms are soundproof, but there are other shows already in progress. Professional: *Please do not bring in ANY outside food or beverage. It’s not allowed any place in the building. Order something to eat or drink with us! *Please do not bring in any backpacks or anything larger than a purse. This is for security and safety reasons. Keep it in the trunk of your car, please! *Please treat the staff, comedians, and guests with courtesy and respect. *Please respect the space. Do not walk through a room to get to another room. Please go and stay in the area where you are performing. If there is a buffet set up for a party or large event, chances are, it’s not your party. Please don’t eat off of any buffets or any special set ups. Supportive *We are asking all comedians to pay a $5 ticket to the open mic and to observe a one-item minimum per person. Comics must be passed by the booking department in order to receive the sign-up links. There are no walk-up performers allowed. The Auditions will continue to remain free and open to all. By purchasing this ticket, You hereby agree to adhere to the above codes in order to create a positive and supportive environment.

name: T.J. Miller
description: T.J. MILLER is a comedian. He has been diligently working to make people laugh for over two and a half years because life is tragic and the best thing he can do is make you giggle and perhaps pee. He is famous in Norway. A skilled improviser, no show is ever the same. Let me repeat that- no show you ever see will be the same. Dare you? See them all? His hour-long comedy specials DEAR JONAH (YouTube), METICULOUSLY RIDICULOUS (HBO) and NO REAL REASON (Comedy Central) are available to stream now wherever streaming is streamed. His forthcoming special THE PHILOSOPHY CIRCUS showcases his talents as a clown, a juggler, and terrible ventriloquist. Is he a musician? No. However, he has two music albums, THE EXTENDED PLAY E.P., a hip-hop/pop/folk music E.P. with 41 tracks, and THE EXTENDED PLAY E.P.: THE ILLEGAL ART REMIXTAPE- available wherever fake music is listened to. Miller’s voice stars as Gene in the EMOJI MOVIE and Fred in Disney’s Academy Award-winning BIG HERO 6. He voiced Tuffnut in the Oscar-nominated HOW TO TRAIN YOUR DRAGON and HOW TO TRAIN YOUR DRAGON 2. He played Auggie in the first R-rated stop-motion film HELL AND BACK, and Prancer in ICE AGE: A MAMMOTH CHRISTMAS. A reindeer! On television, he voiced Robbie from GRAVITY FALLS, Tuffnut in DRAGONS: RIDERS OF BERK, Randy in F IS FOR FAMILY and a volcano in FAMILY GUY. Don’t forget GORBURGER, a show so strange you’ll just have to google it. And that’s his voice. You may recognize his non-animated face and body from DEADPOOL 1 & 2, the highest-grossing R-rated films of all time, forever, 2014’s surprise indie hit TRANSFORMERS 4: AGE OF EXTINCTION, Mike Judge’s HBO series SILICON VALLEY (Critics’ Choice Award for Best Supporting Actor), THOSE WHO CAN’T, GARFUNKEL AND OATS, HAPPY ENDINGS, appearances on KIMMEL, FERGUSON, COLBERT and CONAN, or briefly on THE GOODWIN GAMES (canceled after 7 episodes) or CARPOOLERS (13 episodes). He was on CHELSEA LATELY quite a bit and even guest hosted for Chelsea. A ‘regular’ some might call him. Who those people are he’ll never know. He wrote, produced and starred in the Sundance accepted shorts SUCCESSFUL ALCOHOLICS and I’M HAVING A DIFFICULT TIME KILLING MY PARENTS. Neither won awards. T.J. has been in over 25 major studio films- CLOVERFIELD, SHE'S OUT OF MY LEAGUE, Mike Judge’s EXTRACT, SEEKING A FRIEND FOR THE END OF THE WORLD, ROCK OF AGES, GULLIVER’S TRAVELS, OUR IDIOT BROTHER, YOGI BEAR 3D (for which he gave himself a Critic’s Choice Award for Best Supporting Character in a Talking Bear Comedy), UNSTOPPABLE, GET HIM TO THE GREEK, SEARCH PARTY, THE GOODS: LIVE HARD, SELL HARD, and finally his good friend Jay Baruchel’s GOON: LAST OF THE ENFORCERS.

name: Trixx
description: Taboo shattering, searingly honest, and painfully funny, Frankie “TRIXX” Agyemang is one of North America’s rising comedic stars. Trixx is the 2021 winner of the Boston Comedy Festival, the 2018 Winner of the World Series of Comedy, also 2013 Winner of Just for Laughs’ JFL42 Big Break Competition. He’s been featured on Kevin Hart’s LOL Network, Sirius XM Radio and has opened for such stars as: Tracy Morgan, Damon Wayans, Cedric the Entertainer, Mike Epps, Ryan Hamilton and Sugar Sammy Trixx has written and performed sold out theatre shows including his last show, a two-hour solo show, TRIXX: Unspoken Words, was sold out Toronto’s Jane Mallett Theatre. He has also performed internationally including: London, Boston Comedy Festival, Jamaica Comedy Festival and New York Comedy Festival. Trixx also performed regularly at such top venues as the Just for Laughs Comedy Festival, New York Comedy Festival, The Canadian International Comedy Fest and at Kenny Robinson’s Nubian Disciples of Pryor Comedy Show. Trixx has developed a cult following with his no-holds-barred, take-no-prisoners brand of comedy. Mixing boisterous commentary on topics like pop culture, relationships, music, clubbing, and sex, with acute insights on being black in North America, Trixx’s streetwise, boundary-pushing humour is unafraid of taking on everyone and everything in his sights. A talented entertainer, Trixx got his nickname through his reputation as a prankster while growing-up in Mississauga, Ontario. A former club DJ and MC, Trixx has been an on-air personality on Toronto’s FLOW 93.5 and was a regular on MuchMusic’s Video On Trial. In 2013, he was honoured for a second time with the Comedy Award from COCA. He was also a finalist in the 2009 Great Canadian Laugh Off.

description: Closing Night: The Last Laugh at Flip Flops Comedy Club One more time for the road. We’re closing out the season with a special 30-minute show featuring the people who actually made this place run — the crew behind the bar, on the door, and everywhere in between. Gabriel Perez hosts, joined by Sean Boucher and Nick is Cute <3 for one last set on the Flip Flops stage. Then stick around after the laughs for Rounders with Paper Football — a short film created by Nick is Cute <3 , starring Nate Curran in the lead role, alongside Gabriel , Sean , and a whole bunch of the comics you’ve seen on our stage this season, including Buzz Gordon , Rachel Su , Rachael Liberace , Matt Dundas , and more. Come say goodbye to the season with the people who made it happen. One night only. Let’s end this thing loud. description: Three comics. One stage. Zero chill. We’re throwing the doors open and letting the house comedians take over for one night only. Nate Curran, Nick is Cute <3, and Gabriel Perez are commandeering the club for a Friday night blowout that’s gonna be loud, loose, and absolutely unhinged. Nate Curran is one of the sharpest voices coming out of Biddeford, a driving force behind The Comedy Mill, and a guy who’s been grinding on the New England scene long enough to know exactly how to wreck a room. Nick is Cute <3 is the wild card of the night — a staple of the Maine comedy circuit with a style that’s unpredictable, offbeat, and impossible to pin down. And hosting the whole thing, Gabriel Perez . Chicago-born, world-traveled, and the owner of Flip Flops Comedy Club. He’s hosted for Bob Marley and built this club from the ground up. It’s a Friday night party with the people who make this club what it is. Cold drinks, huge laughs, and three comedians who know each other’s rhythms well enough to turn a set into a full-on jam session. Don’t just come to a show. Come to the party. description: ⭐ Get ready for a wild night of unscripted comedy where *you* might just be part of the act — CROWD WORKIN is coming to Flophouse with fast-paced, fearless fun! Highlights 🎤 A fully improvised stand-up show where the audience becomes part of the punchline. 😂 featuring by the quick-witted Ishmael Gaynor with a rotating cast of bold, hilarious comedians. 🍸 Intimate venue vibes at Flophouse — the perfect spot to grab a drink and enjoy the show. 🔥 No script, no safety net — just pure comedy chaos and unexpected moment CROWD WORKIN isn’t your average stand-up show — it’s a high-energy, totally improvised comedy experience where the audience helps shape the laughs. this unique event puts the spotlight on quick-thinking comics who thrive on the unexpected. Taking place at the cozy and stylish Flophouse Comedy Club the show turns the room into a comedy playground where anything (and anyone) can become material. Expect sharp comebacks, crowd interaction, and a whole lot of laughter. Whether you’re front row or tucked in the back, you’re part of the show. Come ready to sip, laugh, and live a night that’s never the same twice!

name: New York Queer Comedy Festival
description: LAUGH OUT! – Wednesday, October 14 at Greenwich Village Comedy Club New York City’s favorite weekly LGBTQ+ comedy showcase is back with another fabulous night of laughs! Join us Wednesday, October 14, at 7 PM at Greenwich Village Comedy Club for LAUGH OUT! , featuring an incredible lineup of queer comedians, rising stars, and nationally touring talent. This week’s show features Sharon Simon, Internet heartthrob Jack Sullivan, Charles Happel, Demon Twink Dyllon Leather, Kailey Strafford, Ray Ferro, and Jonas Baranca , hosted by the hilarious Devon Arnold ! We’re also welcoming special LA guest James Tyson , returning to New York for a special appearance, alongside Drew Tessier (Netflix) and Tessa Flemming ! Closing out the night is our fabulous headliner, David Mills (BBC) , bringing his signature razor-sharp wit, wicked observations, and deliciously dark humor to the Village stage. Whether you’re part of the LGBTQ+ community or a fabulous ally, LAUGH OUT! is the perfect way to celebrate hump day with some of the funniest people in New York City. SPECIAL EVENT TICKETS. NO DISCOUNT TICKETS OR GROUP ONS ACCEPTED.

name: Stand Up Comedy in Greenwich Village--First stop Friday
description: The Friday Warm-Up: Kick off your weekend at the center of the comedy universe. Forget the standard happy hour. Before the velvet ropes go up and the late-night crowds take over, join us for The Friday Warm-Up—the perfect bridge between “out of the office” and “out on the town.” Located in the heart of Greenwich Village, our early evening showcase features a high-octane lineup of NYC’s hardest-working comics. From SNL writers and Comedy Central veterans to the city’s most explosive rising stars, we deliver a curated 90-minute blast of world-class stand-up that gets you back on the street just as the city is waking up. Why It’s the Best Seat in the City: Prime Time Talent, Early Bird Vibe: Get the same A-list heavy hitters who headline our midnight shows, but with enough time left to grab dinner after. The “Drop-In” Factor: In NYC, you never know who’s working on a new set. Surprise guest appearances from household names are common. The Perfect Pregame: Start your night with a bang. Whether it’s a first date, a birthday, or just surviving the work week, we provide the ultimate Friday fuel.

name: Stand Up Comedy in Greenwich Village--First stop Saturday
description: The Saturday Kickoff: Greenwich Village Live Start your night where New York nightlife began. Before the dinner reservations and the rooftop bars, join us for a high-octane hour of unfiltered stand-up in the heart of the Village. Featuring a curated lineup of comedians seen on Netflix, HBO, and Comedy Central, this 5:00 PM showcase is the ultimate Saturday “Happy Hour” for people who prefer punchlines over small talk. The Vibe: Fast-paced, professional, and perfectly timed to get you to your 7:00 PM dinner.

It’s the perfect high-energy kickoff to your night—expect razor-sharp wit, a packed room, and that unmistakable ‘anything can happen’ energy that only Saturday night in the Village provides.

description: The Village Lab: Where Comedy Legends and Rising Stars Collide. Ever wonder where a Netflix special actually starts? description: JOE LIST is a stand-up comedian who wrote and stars in the movie FOURTH OF JULY (directed by Louis CK), which played theatres all over North America and is currently available on louisck.com. Joe’s previous 2 specials, THIS YEAR'S MATERIAL and I HATE MYSELF, have amassed over 11 million views on YouTube. Joe has performed on THE LATE SHOW WITH DAVID LETTERMAN, THE TONIGHT SHOW WITH JIMMY FALLON and has appeared multiple times on CONAN. He was a finalist on NBC's 'LAST COMIC STANDING, has his own half-hour special on Comedy Central, and also stars in season 2 of Netflix's THE STAND UPS. His albums 'So Far No Good' and 'Are You Mad at Me?' (through Comedy Central Records) can be heard all the time on Sirius Radio. Joe is the co-host of the popular weekly podcast 'Tuesdays with Stories' w/ Mark Normand and he hosts his own podcast MINDFUL METAL JACKET.

name: Fall Down Laughing!
description:
FALL DOWN LAUGHING!

Harvesting the Best in Local Comedy!

Get ready for a night of big laughs as we showcase some of the best comedic talent BC has to offer!

We're bringing together a killer lineup of local favourites, rising stars, and some surprise guests for a night of nonstop laughs.

The twist? It's a SECRET SHOW!

You never know who's going to grab the mic! That's half the fun. No announced lineup, no spoilers, just great comedy and a few surprises along the way.

Come discover your next favourite comedian, support local talent, and enjoy a night of laughs at House of Comedy BC!

October 16 & 17

Grab your tickets, bring your friends, and let the laughs fall where they may!

Item Requirement
A minimum purchase of two menu items (food and/or beverage) per person is required in the showroom.

Age Restrictions

  • Early Show: 16+
  • Late Show: 18+

Arrival Guidelines

  • To ensure optimal seating and timely food and beverage service, we recommend arriving early.
  • Doors open one hour prior to early shows and 30 minutes prior to late shows.
  • Third-party tickets will not be honored. Valid government-issued ID may be required, and the name on the ID must match the name on the ticket.

Preferred Seating (If applies to this performance)
Includes early entry, front-of-line access, and choice of available seating (excluding reserved group seating).

Group Arrivals
Groups of four (4) or more are encouraged to arrive at least 30 minutes before showtime to avoid potential seating separation.

Fees

  • Applicable service fees and taxes will be added at checkout.
  • A 20% automatic gratuity will be applied to groups of six (6) or more in the showroom. Gratuity does not apply to ticket purchases.

Ticket Policies

  • All ticket sales are final and non-refundable.
  • Performer lineups are subject to change without notice.

name: Pedro Gonzalez Special Presentation
description:
Special Presentation – No Passes/Coupons/Groupons Allowed

About Pedro:

Pedro Gonzalez is one of New York’s funniest comedians and the first Latino immigrant to ever perform on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert. Originally from Colombia, he came to the U.S. at 20 with no papers, no English, and no money—but despite his unpromising beginnings he's become an internationally touring comedian with a following of over 300K across Instagram and Facebook. He now lives in New York City with his wife, daughter, and mom, who's helping raise both the baby and Pedro.

description:

Three audience members are randomly selected to serve as judges, and each is given a torch. When all three judges raise their torches, the comedian on stage is immediately eliminated.

Comedians who survive the longest advance to the final lightning round, where they'll have one last chance to win over the crowd. The audience crowns the winner, and they earn the title of Emperor of Rome.

Feeling brave? Audience members will have the opportunity to jump on stage and try their hand at stand-up as well.

Family-owned and operated, Fat Pat's strives to ensure delicious food and family-friendly atmosphere in the Acadiana community. Brothers Aaron and Adam, develop the recipes and oversee day-to-day operations, while Mama Chris handles the books, and Papa Marty takes care of just about everything else!So who is "Fat Pat"? Well, you see, back in the restaurant's early days, Fat Pat's was staffed by family, like many small businesses. One of the cooks went by the nickname, "Fat Pat", and it fit the restaurant's motto, "Never Trust a Skinny Cook!" The name stuck and Fat Pat's Bar & Grill now has four restaurants and more franchised locations in the works.

name: Robert Kelly
description:
Robert Kelly’s comedy is deeply rooted in his own life and relationships, which makes it honest, abrasively funny, yet refreshingly vulnerable. He has been winning over audiences for years, touring clubs, colleges, and theaters, including repeat performances at Montreal’s Just for Laughs Festival.

Robert’s most recent one-hour comedy special, “Kill Box,” can be purchased through robertkellylive.com. Robert is the co-host of The Bonfire on SiriusXM. Robert was on The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon and recurring on the Comedy Central Series This Week At The Comedy Cellar. Besides being a fixture in comedy, Robert played the role of Bobby in the 2022 Fourth of July movie. Robert played Bam Bam in Denis Leary’s FX show Sex & Drugs & Rock & Roll. He can also be seen as Louie CK’s brother Robbie on the hit series Louie. His other acting credits include roles in Unsane, Trainwreck, The Truth About Santa Claus, Maron, Benders, Nurse Jackie, Inside Amy Schumer, and Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn. Robert currently hosts the top-rated podcast “You Know What Dude?” found on iTunes and Patreon.

Robert also co-hosts Calta and Kelly with Mike Calta, as well as, Bone To Pick with Paul Virzi, both found on iTunes and YouTube.

name: Comedy Show: Erica Rhodes Oct. 16th and 17th at Laughs Comedy- Seattle
description: Get ready to laugh your socks off with Erica Rhodes bringing her hilarious vibe to town! Erica Rhodes recently completed a successful run on the 2024 season of America’s Got Talent. She is now touring new material around the country. Erica has appeared on ABC’s Modern Family, HBO’s Veep, and Fox’s New Girl, and was a regular panelist on Comedy Central’s @midnight and Fox’s Punchline. Her standup TV appearances include AGT, Late Night with Stephen Colbert, NBC’s Bring the Funny, and the CW’s Howie Mandel Comedy Extravaganza. Erica was chosen as a New Face for the 2018 Just for Laughs Festival and performed at San Francisco Sketchfest, Moontower Comedy Festival, Blue Whale Comedy Festival, Boston Comedy Festival, and Netflix is a Joke. Erica starred in the ABC Digital series The Off-Season, was a semi-regular performer/writer on NPR’s A Prairie Home Companion, and a recurring character on the Audible series, Dr. Katz: The Audiobook. Her most recent album Ladybug was released in 2023, and both her first album Sad Lemon and Ladybug both hit #1 on the iTunes comedy charts. Her one-hour comedy special La Vie en Rhodes was produced as part of the Tribeca Drive-In Fest and can now be viewed on Amazon Prime. Her Dry Bar special has more than 2 million views on YouTube and can also be viewed on Amazon. Erica currently voices the scene-stealing character of “Dotty” in the hit Netflix animation series, A Tale Dark and Grimm. Bring the Funny judge Jeff Foxworthy described Erica as “the best-defined comic voice of the competition.” Sofia Vergara proclaimed Rhodes “the best comedy act she has ever seen on AGT.”

description: Doors at 6 pm, we have a 2-item minimum menu purchase per person, dinner and drinks. Shows are 18 + years of age. Gus Heagerty is a comedian, actor and director based in New York. The New Yorker described his performances as “miracles of detail”. He has gained an ardent following online for his observational comedy videos. He recently recurred on the NBC series Stumble. As a director, his work has been seen at the Williamstown Theater Festival, Playwrights Horizons, HERE Arts Center, and the Kennedy Center for Performing Arts. He recently featured for Nick Kroll, and can be seen performing live across the country.

description: Comedy and Improv. Presenter: Spontaneous Mind. Asa Erlendson was born in Walnut Creek, CA at John Muir Hospital. No kidding! Asa has been doing improv since 2007, and since then has dibbled, dabbled, or gotten deep into stand-up, mime, clown, dance, music, and sketch, and he also acted in a feature-length movie (A Colorado Road Trip). name: Early Bird Comedy
description: What is a "showcase" show, you ask? It is the quintessential “night at the club,” featuring a host and a lineup of 4-5 comedians who come together to share the stage and create of an incredible, one-of-a-kind night of comedy. Our showcases feature a variety of some of the most talented comics on the scene today, each with their own unique sense of humor and style of delivery. But whether it's a superstar comedian preparing to shoot their next Netflix special or the hottest new comic building some buzz, our showcases are wildly popular for a reason: they are the ultimate, exhilarating, “anything can happen” night of comedy. Grab a drink and bucket of popcorn and get ready to laugh!

name: Jeff Arcuri: Fresh Cut
description: The Chicago Tribune hails Jeff Arcuri as "a joke machine," but he’s much more than that—he’s a person! Jeff has showcased his talent on "The Late Show with Stephen Colbert," Comedy Central’s "Roast Battle," "Laughs!" on Fox, SiriusXM, and numerous comedy festivals nationwide. His subreddit, r/JeffArcuri, ranks in the top 1% of all subreddits, boasting over 235,000 active members. This makes him one of the pioneering comedians on the platform, frequently landing on the front page.Jeff’s ticket-selling prowess has soared dramatically. In spring 2023, he was performing in 200-capacity comedy clubs, but by June 2024, he had ascended to headlining theaters with a capacity of 3,000, consistently selling out 3-5 shows every weekend. In 2024 alone, Jeff sold over 250,000 tickets in over 25 countries.Jeff recently headlined two sold-out performances at the iconic Beacon Theatre for the New York Comedy Festival as well as a four-show sold out residency at The Wiltern in Los Angeles.

description: A mere 30 seconds on her Instagram channel is enough to fall in love with Gauri and her comedy! Her clips have amassed more than 100 million views on social media and gained her a global following. She has headlined top tier comedy clubs and festivals around the world, from Leicester Square Theater in London to WUK in Vienna, to the Melbourne International Comedy Festival in Australia.Gauri enjoys tackling morbid subjects and infusing them with strong punchlines, which she delivers with a natural charisma. Fearless and unabashed, Gauri draws endless material from her cultural background, as well as politics, society, and everyday chaos, crafting sharp jokes into her pointed stand-up routines. And when it comes to crowd work and interacting with the audience, she is undoubtedly in a league of her own.This show is for fans of stand-up that goes beyond the trivial.

description: Chad Anderson is a stand-up comedian currently based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. He’s appeared on CBC and performed at the Winnipeg Comedy Festival, JFL Toronto, JFL Vancouver, Odd Block Comedy Festival and Arctic Air Comedy Festival. Chad’s comedy reflects on his own personal experiences including fatherhood and tragedy as well as subjects ranging from social media to racism. He’s been featured multiple times on CBC’s The Debaters and was a cast member in Mary Walsh’s Canada It’s Complicated. His sophomore album, Live at Lucci’s was released in January 2026 and can regularly be heard on SiriusXM.

name: Mike Vecchione
description: Mike Vecchione is an Italian-American comedian and actor whose stand-up has been described as “rapid-fire delivery, swiftly moving from joke to joke and hitting his punch lines like a boxer working a speed bag.” Mike has made numerous appearances on The Tonight Show, Comedy Central, Netflix, SiriusXM and more. Based in New York City, Mike headlines all across America as well as internationally. In 2020, Mike appeared on the big screen alongside Pete Davidson in the Judd Apatow directed movie The King of Staten Island. Mike also appeared on Netflix’s The Iliza Shlesinger Sketch Show. In 2019, Mike appeared on The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon for a third time and had numerous appearances on Comedy Central’s This Week At The Comedy Cellar. Mike Vecchione was born in Youngstown, Ohio and graduated High School in Boca Raton, Florida. He played football and placed second in the 1991 AAA state wrestling tournament. He attended Pennsylvania State University where he earned a bachelors degree in Criminal Justice and went on to receive a Master’s degree in Special Education from Cabrini College in Pennsylvania. Mike has worked as a counselor and Special Education teacher in the Philadelphia area.

name: Andy Woodhull
description: Andy has appeared on The Late Late Show with James Corden, Conan, Live at Gotham and The Half Hour on Comedy Central. In 2014, he was the first comedian to make his network television debut on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. His Dry Bar comedy special on YouTube has over 9 million views. All five of his comedy albums are in rotation on Sirius Satellite Radio, and his jokes have played over 40 million times on Pandora. Most recently, Andy worked as a writer on SYFY’s The Movie Show, and was featured in two episodes.

name: Chris Franjola (Special Event)
description: ABOUT CHRIS FRANJOLA Chris Franjola is a writer/comedian who can currently be heard on his wildly successful podcast Cover to Cover with Chris Franjola and Heather McDonald’s Juicy Scoop. Cover to Cover has just reached one million downloads and has over 3500 5-star reviews on iTunes and was just voted Pop Sugar's 25 Funniest Podcasts. Chris can also be seen as a contributing panelist on Lights Out with David Spade on Comedy Central and Fox’s comedy game show, Punchline. He was a writer and a regular performer on E!’s hit show “Chelsea Lately" for 8 years. Together with the talented writing staff, Chris wrote over 1500 episodes while performing on the show more than anyone else besides Chelsea Handler and Chuy. During his time on the show, he created some of the show’s most memorable characters like Gay Caveman, Bieber Man, Johnny Depp, Seventeen Magazine Players and many more. He also starred on the critically acclaimed scripted comedy series “After Lately,” which aired for three seasons on E!._He was the host of the Sons of Anarchy aftershow Anarchy Afterword, airing live on FX. Last year Chris released his first comedy album "The Shallow End" which received rave reviews and stayed in iTunes Top 10 Comedy Albums for 5 weeks. Chris has also appeared on The Josh Wolf Show on CMT and Funniest Fails on Fox. When he isn’t busy writing and acting, he’s performing stand-up on the road, headlining venues all over the country. Before Chelsea Lately, Chris wrote for other shows, including Family Guy, the MTV Video Music Awards, and the original Chelsea Handler Show.

name: Jim Florentine
description: For nearly 25 years Jim Florentine has been making audiences around the world laugh across nearly every type of media. Jim has recorded six stand-up comedy albums and shot four full-length specials. On television Jim hosted 7 seasons of VH1 Classic's "That Metal Show" as well as lending his voice to the ground breaking "Crank Yankers". On radio Jim has been a regular on The Howard Stern show, the Opie & Anthony show and currently hosts his own program on Sirius XM. Jim also makes regular appearances on Gutfeld and Kill Tony. In addition Jim is a best selling author, world-renowned voice over talent and has been featured in the film's "Beer League" with Artie Lange and "Trainwreck" with Amy Schumer.

name: Tim Dillon (Special Event)
description: Tim Dillon is a stand-up comedian, writer, and actor known for his no-holds-barred humor and incisive social commentary. On April 15th, Dillon released his highly anticipated stand-up special, I’m Your Mother on Netflix worldwide. Filmed at The Mothership in Austin, the special is a no-holds-barred, unapologetic ride through today’s chaos. With his signature humor, Dillon tackles everything from his odd loyalty to the British royal family to roasting the world’s absurdities and more with no filter. Last fall, the comedian released his Netflix special, Tim Dillon: This Is Your Country, which took on the political and cultural chaos leading up to the 2024 election. Framed as a Jerry Springer-style talk show, the special explores controversial topics and human behavior through Dillon’s interactions with real people and his trademark boldness. Dillon first made waves with his 2022 Netflix special, Tim Dillon: A Real Hero, in which he rants about fast food, living in Texas, Disney adults, and the reason no one should be called a hero. He originally appeared on Netflix in 2018 with a short set as part of The Comedy Lineup. Dillon’s podcast, The Tim Dillon Show, averages a million viewers a week between video and audio downloads. He tours theaters internationally and has been a guest on The Joe Rogan Experience 15 times. On-screen, Dillon recently starred in Eli Roth’s box office hit Thanksgiving and appeared in Todd Phillips' Joker: Folie à Deux.

name: Sam Jay /// October 15-18
description: Stand-up comic and Emmy-nominated writer SAM JAY is best known as the Host and Executive Producer of HBO’s weekly late-night series Pause with Sam Jay. She also co-created and co-starred on the Peacock series Bust Down, with Langston Kerman, Jak Knight, and Chris Redd. She is a two-time Emmy nominee and WGA award nominee for her writing on Saturday Night Live. Sam’s first HBO special, Sam Jay: Salute Me Or Shoot Me, is now available to stream. Sam’s solo show We The People, just wrapped a hugely successful run at Edinburgh Fringe Fest in which the show was nominated for Best Comedy Show, and won The Uprise Award, which recognizes shows that dare to provoke, disrupt and reframe discussions. Sam was a standout on the dais at Netflix’s The Roast of Tom Brady. In 2018, she wrote for The 70th Primetime Emmy Awards and the MTV Movie & TV Awards, and in 2020 she wrote for the BET Awards. Sam was recently featured both on and off camera as the “Voice of God” announcer at the 74th Primetime Emmy Awards on NBC. In 2023, Sam recorded a set as part of Netflix’s Stand Out: An LGBTQ+ Celebration, along with Margaret Cho, Sandra Bernhard, Billy Eichner, and Eddie Izzard—now streaming on Netflix. Sam was named as one of Variety’s 10 Comics to Watch in 2018, and a Comedy Central Comic to Watch in 2015, and in 2017 was selected for Just For Laughs: New Faces Showcase. She has performed on Netflix’s The Comedy Lineup, ABC’s Jimmy Kimmel Live!; and released her Comedy Central Presents half hour to rave reviews. Sam has performed internationally at comedy clubs and festivals including the Vodafone Dublin Comedy Festival, Bumbershoot Festival, 208 Comedy Festival, New York Comedy Festival, Portland’s Bridgetown Festival, The Laugh Your Asheville Off Comedy Festival, Boston’s Women In Comedy Festival, among others. Sam’s 2020 special, Sam Jay: 3 in the Morning, is now available to stream on Netflix. Sam can currently be seen opposite Jonah Hill, Eddie Murphy, and Julia Louis-Dreyfus in the Kenya Barris-directed feature film, You People, now on Netflix. Sam’s other TV credits include her hosting role on Ricking Morty, the Rick and Morty post-show on Adult Swim. Additional TV credits include The Eric Andre Show; HBO Max’s That Damn Michael Che; MTV’s SafeWord; a recurring role on TV Land’s Nobodies; Starz’s Take My Wife, Comedy Central’s White Flight, Crank Yankers, The Meltdown with Jonah and Kumail, and Broad City; and Viceland’s Party Legends and Flophouse. ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿ ____________ This is a full capacity show. All sales are final, unless the event is cancelled or rescheduled. Must be 18+ to attend. You will receive a virtual ticket upon purchase - no need to print your ticket(s).

name: Let's Go Mental - Open Mic
description:
Let's Go Mental - Open Mic @ Hotel Edison Times Square (228 W 47 St New York)

Sign up, show up, go up – 10 comics, cap. 5 mins each.

Join us every Wednesday, 5:00-6:00 PM, at the Hotel Edison's Times Square lobby for "Let’s Go Mental," a free standup comedy open mic supporting the 988 Lifeline, co-sponsored by GuberJokes.com and Stand Up NY. All performance fees are covered by GuberJokes.com, a Smile Message Service that supports mental health and emerging comics.

Please come sign in by 4:55 PM and would appreciate it if you could stay for the hour, respecting other comedians. The mic show is in a public, family-oriented space, so please keep your material PG-13.

Try out new jokes or parts of your usual set. It is a beautiful space, with people coming in and out, expect them to sit and watch or just pass on by. It should be fun; it is a great workout for comedians. Feel free to do crowd work.

Attention Comics: What’s PG-13?

PG-13 means no cursing, no sexually explicit and graphic content, and no suicide jokes. It’s a hotel lobby with families and children present, let’s be respectful and make it fun for everyone! *Please avoid saying the word "suicide" altogether, actually.

description:
A fast-paced improv competition with plenty of (voluntary) audience participation featuring the areas top improv comedians as well as some starry-eyed up-and-comers ready to face their comedic destiny. This show is best for folks who are ready to have fun and be loud, and it is best for folks who are celebrating an event like a birthday or bachelorette party!

Improvisers will each pick one card at a time, each card assigned to a different challenge typically 60-90 second scenes. They will get a chance to succeed with this challenge and advance to the next round, with the top 3 performers in the 3rd round. This show loves to get plenty of participation from the audience or even an opportunity to be an improviser in the show yourself. Audience participation by volunteering only, so no worries if you want to be left alone.

No matter what, we’re doing it together in a way we're all going to love. We debuted this show in July of 2025 and it was an absolute blast for everyone. This is a top show, so expect a big crowd and buy those tickets in advance!

Strongly recommend this show!

description:
The audience takes center stage


When Frank Santos Jr. is on stage, you’re not just a spectator watching a comedy routine. You, your friends, and even strangers in the audience are all potential stars, eagerly awaiting the chance for instant recognition.


Frank Santos Jr. boasts over 20 years of experience


His astonishing array of mind-bending antics can transform any skeptic into a devoted fan. Each performance is always vibrant, energetic, and distinct; no two shows are ever alike.


Frank tailors his show to every occasion


Frank possesses a remarkable talent for reading his audience and adapting his performance to satisfy diverse tastes. His endless variations make it possible for Frank Santos Jr. to entertain everyone, from curious high school students to lively college crowds and nightclubs. He is guaranteed to spark a whirlwind of fun and excitement.


Frank performs nationwide


Frank showcases his talent at numerous theaters across New England, including The Palace Theatre, Colonial Theatre, Capital Center for the Arts, The Wilbur Theatre, and many others. He also performs at Plainridge Park Casino, Twin River Casino, and more. Frank has entertained at major corporate events for companies like Google, Nike, CVS, and Tyco, among others. Additionally, he has made multiple appearances on ABC.

description:

About Chris:

Chris Higgins is a nationally touring comedian from Colorado, now based in Chicago, who brings a unique blend of stoner wisdom, masterful impressions, and outdoorsy sensibilities to stages across the country. Known for his viral stand-up clips that have amassed millions of views, his online sketch series "God n Angel" (1.6M followers), and his comedy special "Live at the Fort," Chris is quickly establishing himself as one of comedy's most distinctive rising voices.

A festival favorite, Chris has performed at the New York Comedy Festival, Netflix is a Joke Comedy Festival, and High Plains Comedy Festival, while taking home "Best of the Fest" honors at both Westend Comedy Festival and 10,000 Laughs Comedy Festival. His comedy has been featured on Don't Tell Comedy, ViceTV, Bob & Tom, and he's currently selling out stops nationwide.

Chris's comedy attracts fans of comics like Rory Scovel, Kyle Kinane, and Mitch Hedberg - audiences who appreciate clever wordplay, unexpected perspectives, and a comedian who proves you can be both laid-back and razor-sharp. Chris combines Colorado's outdoor spirit with Chicago's comedy hustle to create something entirely his own.

Chris would list more credits, but it's generally frowned upon to claim you're the host of the Tonight Show without being Jimmy Fallon.

About Jiaoying:

Jiaoying Summers recently released her Hulu comedy special What Specie Are You? She was named one of Variety’s “10 Comics to Watch” (2025), shining in her debut stand-up hour as she explores what divides us, what unites us, and what belonging truly means. Drawing from her life as a first-generation immigrant, she transforms cultural clashes, identity, and motherhood into razor-sharp comedy that resonates across continents.

An award-winning performer and Asian Hall of Fame inductee, Jiaoying is one of the most influential Asian voices in comedy today. She made history as the first Chinese comedian to headline and sell out the Apollo Theater in New York City. With over 1 billion views and more than 5 million followers, she is a global digital force. Her viral “Uber Karen” sketches and comedic breakdowns of English names have earned her a devoted worldwide fanbase.

Beyond stand-up, Jiaoying is the creator and host of the hit podcast Tiger Mommy, where she interviews comedians, artists, and cultural leaders in intimate, unfiltered conversations. She is also a successful entrepreneur and former Miss China, now owning and operating The Hollywood Comedy and The Green Room Comedy Café, two performance hubs dedicated to elevating diverse and underrepresented comedic talent.

Fearless, modern, and unapologetically sharp, Jiaoying Summers delivers bold commentary on identity, race, gender, and cultural belonging. She is one of the most dynamic and unmissable comedians working today.

You never know who's going to show up and perform on a show like this. You could be witnessing the beginning of the next Dave Chapelle, Amy Schumer, or Kevin Hart.

Plus, our food and drink specials don't hurt either.

description: Sexy sports stars burn up the ice in this funny, filthy spoof of hockey's hottest romance. A full-scale production musical packed with songs, sex jokes, scandal and more pucking innuendos than should legally fit in one show. Lovingly parodying the show that had audiences swooning, blushing and caring about hockey for the first time. From Quick and Funny Musicals, the cult Upright Citizens Brigade LA creators known for turning pop culture obsessions into chaotic comedy musicals, this is an affectionate, outrageous musical send-up of passion, repression and the perfect foreplay to the rest of your night.

name: QFWFQ
description: You are reading about QFWFQ, winner of Best Solo Show at the 2025 Hollywood Fringe. Sold-out Edinburgh run. “The best of the Fringe,” says Arifa Akbar from The Guardian.“Strange, funny, thought provoking and utterly captivating… you'll be enthralled by the journey." - Theatre Weekly ️️️️️️️️️★★★★★“Exhiliarting, word-drunk, surreal and wildly ambitious... it’s a show that demans you keep up.” - The Stage ️️️️★★★★A surrealist labyrinth that stretches time and space. Inspired by Italo Calvino's If On a Winter's Night a Traveller, this razor-sharp, absurdly funny and deeply personal show breaks all genres and has no fourth wall. Join trans artist Gregory Nussen as they rummage through the power and peril of storytelling, growing up Jewish and queer, grappling with geopolitics, and art that saves your life. QFWFQ neither begins, nor ends. How does it come together? I can't explain, but it does.Directed by Hannah Pilkes (HBO’s Hacks, Netflix’s Leanne, Dropout TV).“With the actor's charm, wit and storytelling chops, a playful one-person show.” - The Guardian ️️️️★★★★“This show just might cement Nussen as a new Fringe favourite.” - The Skinny ️️️️★★★★“Sublime… a virtuoso monologue.” - The Scotsman ️️️️★★★★“Clearly assured direction from Hannah Pilkes… genuinely clever and genuinely challenging too.” The Arts Desk ️️️️★★★★Content warning: talk of suicide, genocide.

After years of spreading heinous rumors behind each other’s back on their respective coasts, these two confirmed bachelors reunite along with Kylie Vincent to put on the most unhinged, fundamentally evil showcase of comedic talent.

The Are You Ready Tour brings The Rick Burgess Show live to the stage for an interactive, high energy experience you wont hear on the radio. From stand up comedy and live audience interaction to contests, prizes, and a no holds barred Q&A, every stop on the tour is packed with surprises. And if you think you know the music, think again! Get ready to rock with Mr. Lucky, famously known among fans as the Worlds Greatest Garage Band. This legendary Alabama group, formed by Rick and longtime friends back in the 90s, helped define the shows signature sound and earned that fan given title with performances and memories that still get talked about today. name: St. Louis County Library Foundation Presents D.L. Hughley
description: He was always Charlies Boy - even before he found his name, his voice, his fame. In this deeply personal memoir, acclaimed comedian and cultural critic D.L. Hughley documents his rise from the streets of South Central Los Angeles to the national spotlight - and the man who quietly stood behind him through it all. It was Charlie Hughley - a soft-spoken bag handler at the Los Angeles Airport - who raised D.L. and taught him how to survive through tough love and sacrifice. Though he was not D.L.s biological father, Charlie gave his boy the only thing he truly needed: a sense of being seen. This is not just a coming-of-age story. It is the story of how one man found his voice and learned to get on stage and turn pain into punch lines. This event will be an onstage conversation about D.L. Hughleys memoir "Charlie's Boy" - not a stand-up comedy show. Due to time constraints, there will not be a book signing or photo opportunity at this event. Books provided by EyeSeeMe. | Please note: This event will be an onstage conversation about D.L. Hughleys memoir "Charlie's Boy" - not a stand-up comedy show. Due to time constraints, there will not be a book signing or photo opportunity at this event. Books provided by EyeSeeMe - African American Childrens Bookstore. Proceeds from this event benefit the St. Louis County Library Foundations community literacy initiatives.

name: Leah Lamarr
description: Leah is an internationally touring stand-up comedian, actor, writer, host, podcaster, producer, and icon who rose to prominence in 2020 while being dubbed “the queen of clubhouse” by Joe Rogan on the JRE Podcast. Awarded as Entertainer of the Year by TIME Magazine’s Web3 Division and recognized as a breakout star, Leah has taken her over 800,000 followers on social media along with a passion for technology, comedy, and art to become a fresh and forthcoming star. After becoming the Clubhouse Icon, Leah took her one-hour show to the Edinburgh Fringe Festival and her 2x sold out show at the New York Comedy Festival. She has performed at all major clubs around the nation. Internationally, she performs at all the major clubs in London, Barcelona, as well as at the Dubai Comedy Festival last year. She has featured for Dane Cook, Erik Griffin, Mark Normand and Russell Peters, and now headlines her own dates. She also recently shot a stand-up special for LMAOF TV. As a host she has been seen on E!’s “What the Fashion” and Roku’s “America’s Funniest Home Videos” as well as co-hosting iHeart’s “Real-Time Crime” podcast along with Teddi Mellencamp (RHOBH). She has been seen on HBO’s LaffTracks, CBS’s Code Black, The Late Late Show with James Corden, Comedy Central’s Not Safe with Nikki Glaser, ABC’s How to Get Away with Murder, Amazon Prime’s Jean-Claude Van Johnson and TruTV’s Six Degrees of Everything. She recently had a Verizon campaign come out starring Leah as herself, a rising stand-up comedian. Leah can be seen co-hosting season 2 of Internet Game and performing at The Chosen Comedy Festival. She has been featured in Forbes, Entertainment Tonight, US Weekly, Fast Company, Broadway World, Business Insider, Hypemoon, Hypebae and many more.

name: Phoebe Robinson
description: Phoebe’s in her 40s, so she’s feral aka hella horny and fired up about how chaotic the world is. Since no one is coming to save her or us, Phoebe believes that the problems of life – billionaires, dating, fake ass activism, and QR codes being the new menus at restaurants – are gonna have to be fixed for us, by us. In short, we gotta be our own white knights. So, saddle up, bitches, because we got work to do before we ride off into the sunset and get that happy ending we were promised as kids. PHOEBE ROBINSON is a stand-up comedian, writer, and actress. She is best known as the co-creator and co-star of the hit WNYC Studios podcast 2 Dope Queens, which was turned into four one-hour, critically-acclaimed HBO specials. She is a New York Times best-selling author of the book You Can’t Touch My Hair and Other Things I Still Have to Explain. Following these successes, Phoebe has gone on to be a staff writer for the final season of Portlandia, act in TBS’s Search Party, host another critically-acclaimed podcast for WNYC Studios entitled Sooo Many White Guys, and made her film debut in the Netflix summer comedy Ibiza. Her sophomore book Everything’s Trash, But It’s Okay was published by Dutton.

His debut comedy special, Maybe They’re Dead was recently released via Tiny Pony. Most recently, Ryan can be seen in the 2024 Netflix is a Joke Fest’s Introducing, a showcase of the next great talents in comedy.

Ditch the kids, rally your crew, and blow off steam with moms who get it. (Men are welcome, too!) Audiences are saying “It was amazing, I laughed the whole time!” “BEST girl’s night in a long time.” “I almost pissed my pants!” Atlanta based and nationally touring headliners Holly Ballantine and Amy Brown, have come together to create this special event for moms, women, and those who love them. name: Late Nite Catechism
description: Late Nite Catechism is an uproarious piece of theater that takes audience members back - sometimes nostalgically, sometimes fearfully to the children they once were. The irrepressible Sister teaches an adult catechism to a roomful of students (the audience). Over the course of the play, Sister goes from benevolent instructor, rewarding students for correct answers with glow-in-the-dark rosaries and laminated saint cards, to authoritative drill sergeant. These abrupt mood swings are bound to strike a resonant chord with everyone who survived the ups and downs of going to school, with an omniscient authoritarian at the helm.

name: The Queer Jam
description:
Sundays just got a little gayer! 'The Queer Jam is a new monthly improv show and jam celebrating the LGBTQ+ and queer community, taking over the Sunday Jam, every second Sunday at 5p.

The evening begins with a set from a rotating cast of queer performers, followed by an open jam for (queer only!) improvisers of all levels. Come play, meet people, try stuff, and make some weird little comedy together. Allies are welcome to watch and support from the audience.

Can't make it this time? Catch us every month -- second Sundays (replacing the Jam). Anyone planning on jamming can reserve a ticket for free!

------------------------------------------------------------

FAQs

1. What does “queer-only” mean?
It means the performers on stage is only for people who identify as queer. If that’s you and you want to be in the jam, come!

2. Can straights come to the show?
Yes! We welcome all audience members. Just know that the stage belongs to the queer community. Sit back, laugh, and support some dope comedy.

3. Can I perform in a future show?
If you identify as queer and you’re interested in bringing the funny, come by and put your name in the bucket for the jam portion! That's stage time for you! If you're interested in other ways to perform, let’s talk! Each month will feature an improv set from experienced improvisers in the area, plus sometimes even a stand-up or storyteller!

4. Should I get tickets in advance?
YES. The show may sell out and that's the only way to guarantee space.

5. Is the venue accessible?
Our venue is accessible! There are no stairs, and the first couple of rows are on the floor with movable chairs. The bathroom (yes, singular) is on the same level and accessible to anyone who needs it.

6. Will there be content warnings?
It’s improv comedy—so there's no script. We try to keep things safe and fun for everyone in the room, however because it is all made up on the spot you can expect some adult language and themes, or at least a high probability. If any show includes anything that might need a more specific heads-up (e.g., sensitive topics or flashing light show), we’ll post about it in advance.

name: Vail Comedy Show Pop-Up in Avon - Sam Adams - Westin Avon - Wednesday October 14, 2026 7:30PM
description:
[SPECIAL SHOW AT WESTIN HOTEL -- please arrive early to get parked and find us (complimentary valet and they will direct you to show)]

Vail Comedy Show (www.vailcomedyshow.com) has been described as "amazing", "hilarious", "surprisingly good", and "a fun and different experience". We have shows all year round.

One happy attendee said "Vail Comedy Show blew away my expectations! My stomach and face hurt from laughing."

We fly in nationally touring comedians every month that have been featured in film and television like Late Night with Stephen Colbert on CBS, CONAN, HBO, Comedy Central, NBC and more.

F﻿uture shows and more information at www.vailcomedyshow.com

Doors 7:30PM

Show 8:00PM

Arrive early for best seating

This is a special pop-up show by Vail Comedy Show taking place in Avon.

Sam Adams (@SamAdamsDoesComedy on IG) [Great American Comedy Festival, Dry Bar Comedy, Nate Bargatze's NATELAND Presents, Denver Press Club Hall of Fame] (Denver, CO)

Lisa Lane [NETFLIX, Mom's Unhinged, Clean Comedy Collective] (Denver, CO)

Special Guests

Mark Masters [ABC, Outside TV, AWE Network, Vail Valley Live, Vail Comedy Festival, Boulder Comedy Festival, Antelope Valley Comedy Festival, SnoJam Comedy Festival, Rubber City Comedy Festival, Vermont Comedy Festival] (Colorado)

About the headliner:

An award-winning sports journalist who switched to comedy after winning prizes at the 2009 Great American Comedy Festival. Sam’s two Dry Bar Comedy specials have produced over 50 million social media views. He’s featured on Season 5 of Nate Bargatze’s Nateland Presents: The Showcase.

Sam performs around the country, for comedy clubs and corporate events. He’s also a requested performer for cruise ships. In 2018, comedy fans around the world took notice of Sam’s comedy via social media. the “True Color” clip taken from his first Dry Bar Comedy special went viral. The clip received over 10 million views in less than 72 hours.

Sam Adams spent parts of five decades covering sports for newspapers and electronic media outlets based in Denver, Colorado. His media peers elected him Colorado’s Print Journalist of the Year in 2003. In 2019 Sam became the first African-American sports journalist to be inducted to the Hall of Fame for the Denver Press Club — the oldest press club in the United States.

On stages and pages, Sam Adams is accomplished . . . and highly entertaining!

About the venue:

The Westin Riverfront Resort & Spa is located in the town of Avon, Colorado, on a 19-acre site in the magnificent Vail Valley, providing exceptional access to Beaver Creek Mountain and the Eagle River.

Directions: Guests will valet/park at the Main Hotel (The Westin Riverfront Resort & Spa). Valet parking will be free with validation at the show. The valet staff will direct you to the show.

Frequently this show is held at Lookout Bar which is a gorgeous cocktail bar, sometimes we hold the show in the Riverside Ballroom.

L﻿ineup subject to change.

P﻿hoto/Video disclaimer: You may be photographed or included in video that will be used for future marketing purposes at this event that is open to the public.
