name: Blueprint
description:
Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes.

Past forms have included:
Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa?

Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody.

Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner.

Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath

Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form.

Directed by James Dugan

name: Help Sand Go to the UK!
description:
Sand is heading to the UK! We got into the Birmingham Improv Festival. We've got like the 50-60% of the trip funded, so we thought, "heck, why don't we put on a show and see if that can help us eat all the fish and chips we want!" So please, won't you come out and have some fun with us? Dan Wilcop will be on lights and sound, so this show is a certified "WTAIFY" (We promise To do A really good Improv show For You).

Sand has been one of the best improvisational groups in Chicago since 2009! Named “Chicago’s Best Improv Team” by NewCity, ‘Sand’ is Mike Brunlieb (Hulu’s The Bear, HBO’s South Side, Comedy Central’s Joe Pera Talks With You, and Netflix’s Trial of the Chicago 7) and Thomas Kelly (Showtime’s Work in Progress, NBC’s Shrink, Chicago Med, and the feature film, Monuments). Their unique style of improvisation has led to a devoted following and extensive touring in the United States and internationally.

A Sand show is often laugh out loud funny and heartfelt in equal measure. Brunlieb and Kelly let their long-form exploration of characters evolve in surprising and hilarious ways. “They’re able to tap into a darkness that would lead lesser performers to alienate an audience quickly, And yet they pull it off with a strange sense of empathy that allows for full-on laughter at the most unexpected of topics,” said NewCity Magazine.

Inspired by documentary film, traditional fairy tales, and the spectacle of professional wrestling, Sand's performances are a night of improv that seamlessly transitions into performance art, where the real and the surreal collide. You got to come check it out!

name: Honk!
description: Honk! is a short form, game-based improv show that asks: what good is comedy if you can’t get a little silly? Comprised of some of Chicago’s most seasoned improvisers that firmly believe that fun happens when you let your inner goose loose. So if you’re ready for a gaggle of giggles, join us for one of our upcoming shows! Honk! is for adults so use discretion when considering bringing the goslings.

name: Improv: The Play
description:
With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater.

Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never given a script, and must improvise their way through the scene. The result is a totally original, never before seen piece of theater.

It’s drama, it’s comedy, it’s everything that’s magical about theater and improvisation. Come watch this brand-new show at iO and see something you won’t see anywhere else in the city.

description:
Flirtations and Fangs runs Saturdays at 6:00 pm from October 3rd through October 31st. Reserve your tickets. . . before they mysteriously disappear. Improvised Jane Austen will return to their classic show in November.

This October, Improvised Jane Austen swaps Darcy for Dracula! It’s time to celebrate the scariest season of all: even the refined Jane Austen enjoyed sitting down with a spooky gothic novel (think Twilight, but with even MORE melodrama). Improvised Jane Austen presents: Flirtations and Fangs, an improvised regency rom-com with everyone's favorite love interest: vampires. Experience gothic elements blended with Jane Austen’s signature romantic comedy and social satire. Join us for a witty evening of fright with a little extra bite!

"...countless laughs...whimsical homage to the illustrious author." -- Chicago Reader

Improvised Jane Austen is a comedic ensemble that creates unscripted performances using Jane Austen's tropes, themes, and language to craft a satirical romantic comedy set in Regency-era England. Playing in Austen’s world, Improvised Jane Austen’s stories delight 21st century audiences with a modern sense and sensibility. Come for the humor (and horror), stay for the heart!

"...[They] took it, owned it and created some really funny and touching moments....an evening of silliness and indulgence....make running amok look like delicious fun." -- PerformInk Chicago

Throughout the show’s run, Improvised Jane Austen has been Chicago Reader Recommended, named a PerformInk Critics’ Pick, voted Best sketch/improv troupe 2019 in the Reader’s Best of Chicago, and was featured on WTTW playlist, in Time Out, the Chicago Tribune and on a their list of what to do on Valentine’s Day, on WGN’s Daytime Chicago in 2024 and 2026 and on CBS News Chicago.


“...Improvised Jane Austen is one of the strongest improv troupes in the city. They have the ability to use Austen’s 19th century wit and sarcasm and make it recognizable for a 21st-century audience." --Scapi Magazine

Learn more: https://improvisedjaneausten.com/

description:

Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. Nothing has been planned out, rehearsed, or written. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! You've never seen the Bard like this before!

“There’s really nothing quite like it in the city of Chicago. Smart, sophisticated, downright hilarious.” -TimeOut Chicago

“…the show channels Monty Python as often as the Bard, and frequently with sly-witted results.” -The Chicago Tribune

“Consistently Hilarious” -The Chicago Reader

“Staggeringly Brilliant” -TimeOut Chicago

“Consistently funny…'Tis v'ry, v'ry good.” -The Chicago Tribune

description:
***This is a free show, but it is highly recommended to reserve your ticket here to guarantee entry.*****

Regarded as one of Chicago's funniest and most promising improv groups of the last decade, Dumb John is proud to take the iO Stage with Birdlady in a new weekly long form improv show. Both teams apply their high energy strain of improvisation to a bizarre cultural harvest of small town Americana influence and ephemera, using a single audience suggestion to inspire a piece of unhinged long form improv that propels diesel-soaked characters through fever dream karaoke scenes and down neon aisles of roadside antique marts; exploring the depravity and brilliance found at the heart of every moment.

Take flight with two back to back original iO ensembles, Birdlady and Dumb John! Every Wednesday night at 7:30 (FREE), watch as they migrate toward their ultimate destination: hilarious long-form improvisation! It’ll be a HOOT! They’re so funny this show should be Ill-EAGLE! name: Trilogy of Terror
description:
Step into the shadows for TRILOGY OF TERROR, an evening of spine-tingling original theatre, featuring 3 short plays that explore the strange, the macabre, and the occasionally hilarious.

The Nibbler by Ryan Hultman & Lydia House: Boyfriends Tomas and Baylor visit idyllic small-town America. But when the town’s lore casts a dark shadow, they realize they’ve bitten off more than they can chew.

Gringhost by Sawyer Wade & Renato Sanchez: Abuela and her two granddaughters have just moved into their dream home in the shadow of the late-2000s housing crisis. Little do they know, their new house holds one of the most terrifying horrors of all time... the ghost of a white lady!

No Good Deed by Lisa Burton: A Ted Talk where a Doctor-Without-Borders faces supernatural judgment for humanitarian achievements.
